name: Competitive Esports (CS2)
description: Low-latency profile for a competitive shooter: the game is pinned to performance cores, given High priority and the high-performance GPU, while background browsers drop to Idle instead of being suspended so nothing is lost mid-match.
notes: On a CPU without efficiency cores the affinity plan falls back to every logical processor; the rest of the profile still applies.
Priorities are only lowered, never raised, so nothing is suspended while a match is in progress.
Network tuning is limited to the interface carrying an established TCP server flow; the adapter's interrupt-moderation property is skipped when the driver does not expose it.
